22b0ef0878994682b70e.description:
**University Overview**

The University of Pennsylvania, the largest private employer in Philadelphia, is a world-renowned leader in education, research, and innovation. This historic, Ivy League school consistently ranks among the top 10 universities in the annual U.S. News & World Report survey. Penn has 12 highly-regarded schools that provide opportunities for undergraduate, graduate and continuing education, all influenced by Penn’s distinctive interdisciplinary approach to scholarship and learning. As an employer Penn has been ranked nationally on many occasions with the most recent award from Forbes who named Penn one of America’s Best Large Employers in 2023.

Penn offers a unique working environment within the city of Philadelphia. The University is situated on a beautiful urban campus, with easy access to a range of educational, cultural, and recreational activities. With its historical significance and landmarks, lively cultural offerings, and wide variety of atmospheres, Philadelphia is the perfect place to call home for work and play.

The University offers a competitive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare and tuition benefits for employees and their families, generous retirement benefits, a wide variety of professional development opportunities, supportive work and family benefits, a wealth of health and wellness programs and resources, and much more.

**Posted Job Title**

Graduate Coordinator, History of Art, Penn Arts and Sciences

**Job Profile Title**

Coordinator, Program

**Job Description Summary**

The Program Coordinator independently manages the History of Art graduate program and the Art and Archaeology of the Mediterranean World (AAMW) graduate group and provides complex academic and operational support to the Department of the History of Art. The position manages the graduate student lifecycle from application through graduation; advises students and faculty on University and Graduate Division policies and procedures; prepares reports and maintains program data; and serves as a primary liaison to the Graduate Division and other University offices. In addition to graduate program administration, the position coordinates departmental projects and operations, curriculum administration, events and programming, routine purchasing and defined program/event budgets, facilities needs, immigration processes, and student-worker supervision. The role requires independent judgment, initiative, data-informed problem-solving, and coordination across multiple functional areas with limited day-to-day supervision.

**Job Description**

Welcome to one of the country's leading programs for the History of Art and one of the most active organizations on the Penn campus. At home in the Jaffe History of Art Building, we are located at both a physical and a virtual crossroads for Penn's vibrant community of students and teachers.

We offer a wide variety of undergraduate instruction to satisfy the curiosity and pique the interest of students. General liberal arts majors and specialists are provided for equally. Our courses regularly transport students to Philadelphia's museums, galleries and historic sites, and we offer seminars in collaboration with the Institute of Contemporary Art and the Arthur Ross Gallery, in which students devise and organize exhibitions. The department is home to the Visual Studies program and is a significant contributor to the Cinema and Media Studies major.

Our renowned graduate program is sustained by the Faculty of the Graduate Group in the History of Art, whose collegial appointments drawn from elsewhere in the University enriches the scope and expands the size of the department. The department also hosts the Graduate Group in the Art and Archaeology of the Mediterranean World, underscoring the breadth of our interests.

**Responsibilities:**

* Independently manage the History of Art and AAMW graduate programs from admissions through graduation, including registration, academic progress, benchmarks, fellowships, funding records, exams and defenses, degree completion, program data, and reporting
* Advise graduate students and faculty on University and Graduate Division policies, procedures, deadlines, and resources; identify and resolve administrative issues and serve as liaison to the Graduate Division and other University offices
* Coordinate departmental projects and operations, facilities needs, administrative resources, correspondence, issue resolution, and student-worker hiring, training, scheduling, and supervision
* Coordinate curriculum and course administration, including scheduling, permits, room assignments, enrollment information, and updates in NGSS, CLSS/Curriculum Manager, and related systems
* Plan and coordinate departmental academic events and programming, including workshops, colloquia, recruitment and orientation activities, speakers, travel, lodging, catering, communications, event budgets, and expense tracking
* Coordinate routine operational purchasing and defined program/event expenses, monitor spending against approved budgets or funding allocations, and partner with the department’s Financial Specialist and SAS Finance on specialized processing
* Coordinate departmental components of immigration-related requests in partnership with ISSS and other University offices.

This position requires regular on-site presence to effectively perform its essential functions and support departmental operations.

**Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree and 2-3 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, is required.
* Experience in higher education or academic administration is strongly preferred.
* The successful candidate will demonstrate excellent organizational, written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; sound judgment and discretion; initiative; and the ability to independently manage multiple complex priorities and deadlines.
* Experience advising students or faculty, interpreting policies and procedures, coordinating academic programs, supervising student employees, and working across multiple administrative functions is preferred.
* Familiarity with Penn systems such as NGSS, CLSS/Curriculum Manager, Grad Funding, Concur, Penn Marketplace, or comparable systems is highly desirable.
* This position requires regular on-site presence to effectively perform its essential functions and support departmental operations.

**Job Location - City, State**

Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

**Department / School**

School of Arts and Sciences

**Pay Range**

$24.21 - $31.00 Hourly Rate

Salary offers are made based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and education as they directly relate to the requirements of the position, and in alignment with salary ranges based on external market data for the job’s level. Internal organization and peer data at Penn are also considered.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

The University of Pennsylvania is an equal opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, religion, creed, national origin (including shared ancestry or ethnic characteristics), citizenship status, age, disability, veteran status or any class protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

**Special Requirements**  
Background checks may be required after a conditional job offer is made. Consideration of the background check will be tailored to the requirements of the job.

**University Benefits**

* **Health, Life, and Flexible Spending Accounts**: Penn offers comprehensive medical, prescription, behavioral health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits to protect you and your family’s health and welfare. You can also use flexible spending accounts to pay for eligible health care and dependent care expenses with pre-tax dollars.
* **Tuition**: Take advantage of Penn's exceptional tuition benefits. You, your spouse, and your dependent children can get tuition assistance here at Penn. Your dependent children are also eligible for tuition assistance at other institutions.
* **Retirement:** Penn offers generous retirement plans to help you save for your future. Penn’s Basic, Matching, and Supplemental retirement plans allow you to save for retirement on a pre-tax or Roth basis. Choose from a wide variety of investment options through TIAA and Vanguard.
* **Time Away from Work:** Penn provides you with a substantial amount of time away from work during the course of the year. This allows you to relax, take vacations, attend to personal affairs, recover from illness or injury, spend time with family—whatever your personal needs may be.
* **Long-Term Care Insurance:** In partnership with Genworth Financial, Penn offers faculty and staff (and your eligible family members) long-term care insurance to help you cover some of the costs of long-term care services received at home, in the community or in a nursing facility. If you apply when you’re newly hired, you won’t have to provide proof of good health or be subject to underwriting requirements. Eligible family members must always provide proof of good health and are subject to underwriting.
* **Wellness and Work-life Resources**: Penn is committed to supporting our faculty and staff as they balance the competing demands of work and personal life. That’s why we offer a wide variety of programs and resources to help you care for your health, your family, and your work-life balance.
* **Professional and Personal Development:** Penn provides an array of resources to help you advance yourself personally and professionally.
* **University Resources:** As a member of the Penn community, you have access to a wide range of University resources as well as cultural and recreational activities. Take advantage of the University’s libraries and athletic facilities, or visit our arboretum and art galleries. There’s always something going on at Penn, whether it’s a new exhibit at the Penn Museum, the latest music or theater presentation at the Annenberg Center, or the Penn Relays at Franklin Field to name just a few examples. As a member of the Penn community, you’re right in the middle of the excitement—and you and your family can enjoy many of these activities for free.
* **Discounts and Special Services**: From arts and entertainment to transportation and mortgages, you'll find great deals for University faculty and staff. Not only do Penn arts and cultural centers and museums offer free and discounted admission and memberships to faculty and staff. You can also enjoy substantial savings on other goods and services such as new cars from Ford and General Motors, cellular phone service plans, movie tickets, and admission to theme parks.
* **Flexible Work Hours:** Flexible work options offer creative approaches for completing work while promoting balance between work and personal commitments. These approaches involve use of non-traditional work hours, locations, and/or job structures.
* **Penn Home Ownership Services:** Penn offers a forgivable loan for eligible employees interested in buying a home or currently residing in West Philadelphia, which can be used for closing costs or home improvements.
* **Adoption Assistance:** Penn will reimburse eligible employees on qualified expenses in connection with the legal adoption of an eligible child, such as travel or court fees, for up to two adoptions in your household.

*To learn more, please visit:* *https://www.hr.upenn.edu/PennHR/benefits-pay*

0811bbc65c01fc1c2227.title: Implementation Manager
0811bbc65c01fc1c2227.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Implementation team at Vividly plays a critical role in turning a customer's solution design into a successful, operational Vividly experience.

Our Implementation Managers are both **hands-on platform configurators and end-to-end project managers**. They take an approved solution design and translate it into Vividly configuration, customer workflows, data setup, training, testing, and ultimately go-live.

Implementation Managers serve as the primary point of contact throughout onboarding, coordinating across customers, Solution Architecture, Integrations, Managed Services, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to keep complex projects moving forward.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, understanding complex workflows, configuring software, managing multiple moving pieces, and creating an onboarding experience that gives customers confidence they made the right investment.

**Who You Are**

You are an energetic, curious, and highly accountable implementation professional who enjoys being in front of customers as much as you enjoy getting into the details of how a platform should be configured.

You're comfortable taking an approved solution design, understanding the business intent behind it, and turning it into something real. You can work through complex business workflows, translate requirements into accurate platform configuration, work confidently with customer data, and explain how the resulting experience will work for the people using it.

You're also a strong project manager. You can manage multiple implementations at once, keep customers and internal teams accountable, identify dependencies before they become blockers, and create momentum without sacrificing quality.

You don't need to design every solution from scratch, but you do need to understand the solution you're implementing. You ask questions when something doesn't make sense, recognize when customer requirements have materially changed, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and know when to bring Solution Architecture back into the conversation before changes create unnecessary complexity, scope creep, or rework.

Most importantly, you bring energy to the customer experience. You're engaged, passionate about helping customers succeed, comfortable leading a room, and genuinely enjoy seeing customers move from complicated processes to confidently operating in Vividly.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end implementation project for assigned customers, from post-Solution Alignment through configuration, training, UAT, go-live, and transition.
* Serve as the primary project manager and day-to-day customer lead throughout onboarding, owning timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, customer actions, and overall project health.
* Translate approved Solution Architecture designs into accurate, scalable Vividly platform configuration.
* Configure customer workflows, master data, promotion structures, deduction-related settings, reporting requirements, user access, and other applicable platform components based on the approved solution.
* Understand the business purpose behind the configuration, not simply the individual fields or settings being configured.
* Prepare, transform, import, map, and validate customer datasets, including customer, product, pricing, revenue, and other applicable data.
* Validate configured workflows against the approved solution design and expected customer experience before progressing into training, UAT, and go-live.
* Lead customer implementation meetings with confidence, clear direction, and strong follow-through.
* Hold customers and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed actions, decisions, and timelines.
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and decisions that could impact scope, timeline, or customer readiness and drive them toward resolution.
* Coordinate cross-functional onboarding workstreams, including Integrations and Managed Services, while maintaining visibility into dependencies that impact the overall implementation.
* Deliver initial platform and workflow training to establish customer operational readiness and prepare users to begin successfully working in Vividly.
* Guide customers through UAT and confirm that configured workflows operate as intended before go-live.
* Assess customer readiness across configuration, data, training, integrations, services dependencies, and outstanding customer actions.
* Complete structured handoffs to Customer Success and Managed Services, ensuring important customer context, business outcomes, decisions, risks, and outstanding actions carry forward after implementation.
* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams when additional expertise is required.
* Identify recurring implementation challenges and contribute to improving our playbooks, templates, automation, processes, and overall customer onboarding experience.

**Solution Design & Change Management**

Implementation Managers execute against an approved solution design while maintaining enough business and product context to recognize when that design may need to be revisited.

In this role, you will:

* Use the approved Solution Architecture design as the source of truth for configuration and implementation execution.
* Understand the business requirements, assumptions, decisions, and intended customer experience behind the solution you're implementing.
* Recognize when newly discovered requirements or customer requests materially differ from the approved design.
* Challenge assumptions when a requested change could introduce unnecessary complexity, downstream risk, or significant rework.
* Distinguish between configuration decisions you can independently make and material solution changes that require Solution Architecture to re-engage.
* Escalate material design changes, new requirements, scope changes, or unresolved solution questions before changing the approved design.
* Document implementation decisions and ensure material changes are reflected in the appropriate solution and project documentation.
* Help customers move toward scalable future-state workflows rather than automatically recreating legacy processes simply because that's how they've historically operated.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3–5+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, implementation consulting, customer onboarding, or a similar customer-facing delivery role.
* Demonstrated experience hands-on configuring a SaaS platform based on documented business requirements or solution designs.
* Proven experience independently managing customer implementations from configuration through UAT, go-live, and handoff.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer projects with competing priorities, dependencies, stakeholders, and deadlines.
* Ability to understand complex business workflows and translate approved requirements into accurate system configuration.
* Strong judgment and the ability to recognize when a customer request represents a normal configuration decision versus a material change to an approved solution.
* Experience working with customer datasets using Excel or Google Sheets, including data validation, transformation, mapping, filtering, pivoting, and troubleshooting.
* Strong project management and organizational skills with an ability to create structure, maintain momentum, and drive accountability.
* Excellent customer-facing communication and facilitation skills, including the confidence to lead meetings, ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and explain complex workflows in practical terms.
* Strong problem-solving skills and comfort operating in ambiguity without waiting for someone else to provide every answer.
* Demonstrated ability to identify implementation risks early and drive decisions toward resolution.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities, processes, and products continue to evolve.
* A genuine passion for customer experience and helping customers successfully adopt new technology.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience implementing financial, ERP, accounting, planning, supply chain, retail, or other workflow-heavy SaaS products.
* Experience working with ERP systems, integrations, APIs, data migrations, or system-to-system workflows.
* Experience in consumer packaged goods (CPG), retail, trade promotion management (TPM), sales planning, finance, or accounting.
* Experience leading UAT, customer training, and change-management activities.
* Experience using AI or automation to improve implementation workflows, documentation, data preparation, configuration QA, or project efficiency.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first several months, you'll be able to independently take an approved customer solution and:

* Turn it into an accurate, operational Vividly configuration.
* Confidently lead the customer through their implementation plan and maintain momentum toward go-live.
* Manage multiple implementations simultaneously without sacrificing quality or customer experience.
* Understand enough of the customer's business process to explain why the platform is being configured a certain way—not simply how to configure it.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and potential design changes before they create downstream rework.
* Know when to make a configuration decision independently and when to bring Solution Architecture or another specialist back into the conversation.
* Prepare customers for successful go-live and provide Customer Success and Managed Services with a clean, structured handoff.
* Consistently deliver implementations that are on time, within scope, and positioned for long-term customer adoption and value.

**Why Choose Vividly?**

**A modern, remote-first workplace**

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable, productive home office.

**Vividly days off & flexible PTO**

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (*and we really mean it*) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

**Competitive Benefits**

* Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
* 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
* Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
* Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

**Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code**

* **Kind Ambition** -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
* **Keep It Real** - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
* **Customer Love** - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
* **Own It** - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
* **Urgency Wins** - We move quickly and focus on impact
* **Pull Together** - We collaborate to win as a team

**Please note:** Vividly will never request sensitive information such as your social security number, bank account information, or other non-publicly available information during the application and interview process. If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

* Contact initiated via unsolicited text message or cold call. Vividly does not follow up with candidates through instant messaging applications.
* Our Talent Acquisition team only corresponds from email addresses with the domain ‘@govividly.com’. If a generic email ID ending with Gmail/Yahoo or other domain is used while receiving a job offer or interview call, there is a likelihood of a scammer.
* While some of our jobs can be found on third party job sites, all of our current job opportunities and descriptions are posted on Vividly’s Careers page, or our official LinkedIn Company Page

The U.S. Federal Trade Commission has published helpful articles to help individuals learn more about protecting themselves from recruiting scams and financial fraud. If you believe you were a victim of such a scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agencies. Vividly is not responsible for any claims, liability, losses, damages, or expenses resulting from scammers or impersonators.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
80,000 - 100,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

47decce9a2eb0c8c753a.title: Recovery Project Coordinator
47decce9a2eb0c8c753a.description:
**ID**j-17128

**Job Type**Full Time

**Remote Type**Full Remote

**Job Summary**

The Recovery Project Coordinator provides project management support for complex environmental, natural resources, infrastructure, and recovery-related projects. Working under the direction of a Project Manager or Program Manager, this position is responsible for tracking project progress, coordinating activities among internal subject matter experts, clients, and subcontractors, monitoring schedules and deliverables, facilitating communication, identifying potential project risks, and helping ensure work is completed on time and within scope.

The position serves as a central coordination point across multidisciplinary teams and helps keep projects organized, moving forward, and aligned with client expectations. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, proactive communication, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Supervisory Responsibilities****:** No

**Job Classification:** Full-Time; Non-Exempt

**Duty Station****:** Remote

**Safety Sensitive****:** Yes

**Travel:** Up to 25% contingent upon business needs

**Duties/Responsibilities**

* Coordinate day-to-day project activities across multiple teams and projects to support successful project execution and timely delivery of work products.
* Monitor project schedules, milestones, action items, and deliverable deadlines to ensure project activities remain on track.
* Track progress against established project work plans, identify potential scheduling risks, and follow up with team members regarding outstanding tasks and upcoming deadlines.
* Assist in ensuring project deliverables are completed in accordance with established scope, schedule, and quality requirements.
* Develop, update, and maintain project tracking systems, schedules, dashboards, and other project management tools.
* Coordinate technical inputs, information, and work products from subject matter experts, technical specialists, and project team members.
* Schedule and facilitate internal project meetings, including coordinating meeting logistics, preparing agendas, documenting meeting minutes, and tracking action items.
* Assist project managers in coordinating interdisciplinary teams, managing project workflows, and ensuring follow-through on assigned responsibilities.
* Gather and organize technical information from project specialists to support reports, client communications, and project deliverables.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for routine project communications between clients, internal staff, and subcontractors.
* Coordinate meetings, information requests, data collection activities, and project reviews involving clients, subcontractors, and internal project teams.
* Monitor subcontractor schedules, project activities, and deliverable commitments to ensure alignment with overall project requirements.
* Communicate project status updates, outstanding action items, and emerging issues to project managers and leadership.
* Support client relationship management through timely communication, coordination of project activities, and tracking and resolution of project-related issues.
* Develop and maintain project status reports, dashboard summaries, and other reporting tools to monitor project performance.
* Track project budgets, schedules, milestones, and deliverable completion status to support project oversight and reporting requirements.
* Prepare and maintain meeting notes, action item logs, decision records, and other project documentation.
* Assist with monthly project reporting, invoicing processes, and the preparation of supporting documentation.
* Provide project managers with accurate and timely project information to support planning, decision-making, and overall project management.
* Identify potential project bottlenecks, resource conflicts, scheduling delays, and other risks that may impact project performance.
* Escalate project issues requiring management attention and assist in tracking the resolution of identified risks and outstanding action items.
* Support the implementation of corrective actions to address project challenges and maintain established schedules and deliverable requirements.
* Maintain organized, accurate, and current project files, records, and documentation in accordance with company and client requirements.
* Assist with project work planning, resource coordination, and the development of scopes of work, task orders, and project execution plans.
* Coordinate internal quality control reviews, project deliverable reviews, and client submittals to ensure completeness and compliance with project requirements.
* Ensure project documentation, tracking systems, and records are maintained and updated throughout the project lifecycle.
* This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**Required Skills/Abilities**

* Active and valid driver’s license maintained throughout employment.
* Exceptional organization and time-management skills.
* Ability to keep multiple tasks and teams moving simultaneously.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to build productive relationships with clients, technical staff, and subcontractors.
* Ability to identify issues before they become problems.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
* Attention to detail and follow-through.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Excel, Word, Planner, SharePoint.
* Ability to develop reports, meeting summaries, action logs, and schedule tracking tools.
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills.
* Supporting federal, state, or local government clients.
* Coordinating subcontractors or consultant teams.
* Supporting NEPA, land management, engineering, construction, or recovery projects.
* Project management software and reporting tools.

**Education and Experience**

* **Required****:** Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Natural Resources, Environmental Science, Forestry, Planning, Public Administration, Business Administration, Communications, Engineering or a related field from a regionally or nationally accredited university
* **Req****uired****:** At least Three (3) to Seven (7) years of experience in coordination, project management, or program support experience
* **Required:** Experience supporting NEPA, land management, engineering, construction, or recovery projects.
* **Required:** Experience supporting environmental, natural resources, infrastructure, restoration, or disaster recovery projects.
* **Preferred:** Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

**Physical Requirements**

* Active and valid driver’s license maintained throughout employment
* Must possess and maintain valid identification required for commercial air travel and be able to travel by air as required to support business operations
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, etc.

  

**Benefits**

Eligible employees receive the following benefits:

* Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* MDLIVE
* Benefit Hub
* Paid Annual Leave/PTO
* Paid Sick Leave
* Paid Holidays
* 401(k)
* Basic Life
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Accident Insurance
* Short Term Disability
* Long Term Disability
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**Pre-employment Requirements**

Due to the nature of Chloeta’s services, this position is contingent upon completing with a satisfactory outcome some or all of the following pre-employment background screenings: government security clearance, federal and state criminal background checks, drug test (urinalysis), Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) review, educational history, employment history, and/or credit check. In accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), pre-employment background screenings will require the employee’s written authorization and will occur after acceptance of an offer of employment and prior to commencing work. Additionally, employees are required to complete the federal I-9/E-Verify process.

**Drug and Alcohol Testing Policy**

Employees may be subject to undergoing additional drug screens and/or alcohol testing at any time during the period of employment, including without prior notice.

**Safety-Sensitive Position**

This position has been designated as a safety-sensitive position due to the nature of the work performed and the potential consequences of impaired job performance. Employees in safety sensitive positions may operate vehicles or equipment, work in hazardous environments, respond to emergencies, access critical infrastructure, handle hazardous materials, or perform duties where the exercise of sound judgment, coordination, alertness, and the ability to respond quickly and appropriately are essential. Impaired performance in these duties could create an unreasonable risk of injury or illness to the employee, coworkers, clients, or the public; result in damage to property, equipment, or the environment; or adversely affect client operations, emergency response efforts, or mission success.

**EEO Statement**

Chloeta provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

**About Chloeta**

Chloeta is a Native American owned enterprise providing a diverse range of engineering, scientific, and technical solutions to support military, energy, homeland security, emergency preparedness, and critical infrastructure requirements.

b3851818a6e34122a81f.title: Direct Sales Program Manager
b3851818a6e34122a81f.description:
**Direct Sales Program Manager**  
**Department:** Direct Sales  
**Reports To:** Director of Direct Sales  
**Location:** Remote  
**FLSA Status:** Exempt  
**Compensation:** TBD Base Salary + Performance-Based Commission/Incentive (Target OTE: TBD)  
**Position Summary**  
The **Direct Sales Program Manager** is responsible for the coordination, execution, and continuous improvement of programs and initiatives supporting the Direct Sales Channel. This role helps ensure Direct-to-Door (D2D), reseller, Multi-Dwelling Unit (MDU), EMA/NEMA, and other direct sales initiatives are effectively implemented, measured, and supported across the organization.  
The Program Manager serves as a key operational resource for the Direct Sales organization, working closely with the Director of Direct Sales and cross-functional teams to coordinate market initiatives, improve processes, track performance, manage program requirements, and resolve operational barriers impacting sales execution and the customer experience.  
This role partners with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Construction, Customer Care, Finance, and billing to ensure Direct Sales programs are aligned, scalable, measurable, and positioned to support customer acquisition and revenue growth.  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**  
**Direct Sales Program Management**

* Coordinate the planning, implementation, and ongoing management of Direct Sales programs and initiatives.
* Support D2D, D2D resellers, MDU, EMA/NEMA, and other customer acquisition programs within the Direct Sales Channel.
* Develop and maintain program documentation, processes, workflows, timelines, and performance tracking.
* Coordinate program launches and market deployments with internal departments and external partners.
* Monitor program execution and identify operational gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support the Director of Direct Sales with strategic initiatives designed to expand and strengthen the Direct Sales Channel.
* Maintain visibility into program priorities, deliverables, progress, and outstanding action items.

**Reseller & Partner Program Support**

* Support the operational management of reseller and referral partner programs.
* Coordinate reseller onboarding, market launches, training requirements, system access, and ongoing program support.
* Facilitate regular partner business reviews and assist with performance reporting and follow-up action items.
* Monitor partner sales activity, connects, cancellations, sales quality, ARPU, and other applicable program metrics.
* Coordinate reseller needs and operational requirements with internal stakeholders.
* Help identify program opportunities that support additional market penetration and customer acquisition.

**Sales Operations & Performance Analytics**

* Develop and maintain reporting used to measure Direct Sales program performance.
* Track sales activity, connects, cancellations, conversion, ARPU, productivity, and other key performance indicators.
* Analyze program results and identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring additional attention.
* Assist with sales forecasting, market planning, deployment planning, and performance reporting.
* Prepare program updates, executive summaries, business reviews, and recommendations for Direct Sales leadership.
* Maintain accurate program documentation and reporting to support business decisions.

**MDU, EMA & NEMA Program Management**

* Coordinate Direct Sales activities associated with MDU, EMA, and NEMA programs and agreements.
* Track properties, opportunities, program requirements, deployment status, sales activity, and results.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to support successful program implementation and ongoing execution.
* Identify operational barriers affecting customer acquisition within participating properties or programs.
* Support initiatives designed to increase penetration and customer acquisition within existing programs and properties.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Serve as a liaison between Direct Sales and internal departments supporting sales execution.
* Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Construction, Customer Care, Finance, and other stakeholders on program requirements and deliverables.
* Facilitate communication and follow-up on issues affecting Direct Sales programs, reseller partners, field representatives, or customers.
* Coordinate market readiness activities and help ensure sales programs are aligned with operational capabilities.
* Maintain clear accountability for program action items, dependencies, and deliverables.

**Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Evaluate Direct Sales workflows and recommend opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and consistency.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, program guidelines, job aids, and other operational documentation.
* Support improvements to order processes, reporting, reseller workflows, market launches, and customer experience.
* Help establish standardized processes and controls across Direct Sales programs.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to implement process changes and monitor results.
* Identify recurring operational issues and coordinate sustainable solutions rather than relying solely on individual issue resolution.

**Customer & Partner Escalation Coordination**

* Coordinate complex customer, reseller, and program-related escalations requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Ensure appropriate stakeholders are engaged and action items are clearly documented and tracked through resolution.
* Identify recurring escalation trends and recommend process improvements that address root causes.
* Maintain communication with appropriate stakeholders throughout the resolution process.

**Program Governance & Compliance**

* Support adherence to established Direct Sales policies, processes, contractual requirements, and sales quality standards.
* Assist with monitoring program compliance and identifying areas requiring corrective action or process improvement.
* Maintain program documentation and records necessary to support consistent execution.
* Partner with appropriate stakeholders to address compliance, sales quality, and process concerns.

**Qualifications**  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2+ years of experience in program management, Direct sales operations, channel management, business operations, telecommunications, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple initiatives involving cross-functional stakeholders.

1de262d472d7ec465feb.title: Change Coordinator/ Document Controller
1de262d472d7ec465feb.description:
**About the Job**

We are seeking a highly organized Change Coordinator / Document Controller to provide the logistics, coordination, and documentation backbone for change and readiness work across a multi-function enterprise transformation program.

This role is well suited to someone with several years of experience in administration, operations, project coordination, PMO, document control, change management, or similar organizational roles who is comfortable creating structure, coordinating across multiple stakeholders, and keeping complex workstreams organized.

Direct change-management experience is valuable, but strong administrative, operational, or project-management experience may be equally relevant if you have demonstrated the ability to manage documentation, track multiple workstreams, coordinate stakeholders, and work independently.

This is a people- and process-transformation program focused on stakeholder engagement, readiness assessments, and adoption tracking across several business functions. It is not a systems or IT deployment.

Functions on this program will move through readiness and adoption at different paces. The structure you build needs to track each function's status individually while maintaining consistency across the overall program.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain change-side logistics including scheduling, meeting coordination, agendas, materials, and follow-up
* Coordinate meetings and working sessions across multiple stakeholders, functions, and leaders
* Own and maintain documentation for stakeholder maps, readiness assessments, adoption tracking, action items, and related change materials
* Maintain version control and a clean, organized document repository
* Keep readiness and adoption trackers current as different functions progress through change at different paces
* Support stakeholder and leader-sponsor engagement sessions with meeting logistics, materials, notes, and follow-up
* Track outstanding actions, decisions, dependencies, and documentation needs
* Identify missing, outdated, inconsistent, or unclear information and proactively close documentation gaps
* Support consistent formatting, organization, and structure across function-level change materials
* Build and improve tracking systems, templates, and organizational processes where they do not already exist
* Provide general coordination and operational support across the change workstream as priorities evolve
* Use AI tools to accelerate documentation, organization, meeting preparation, tracking, and administrative workflows

**QualificationsRequired**

* 3–5+ years of professional experience in administration, operations, project coordination, PMO, document control, change management, executive support, or a related coordination role
* Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, documents, and workstreams simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader objective
* Experience maintaining trackers, documentation, meeting records, action logs, repositories, or similar operational systems
* Ability to create structure and processes from general direction rather than requiring every step to be defined
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace
* Experience with SharePoint, Google Drive, Confluence, or similar document repositories
* Comfort working independently in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities
* Experience working in a consulting, client-services, transformation, operations, or multi-function environment is highly valued

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience supporting organizational change, process transformation, readiness, adoption, or business transformation
* Experience coordinating across multiple business functions or stakeholder groups
* Prior PMO, project coordination, or project management experience
* Prior experience working as a 1099 independent contractor or supporting commercial client engagements
* Experience with stakeholder maps, readiness assessments, adoption tracking, action logs, RAID logs, or similar transformation-management tools
* Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms as a routine part of daily workflow

**Important:** Candidates do not need to have held the title "Change Coordinator" or "Document Controller." Candidates with strong backgrounds in administration, operations, project management, PMO, executive coordination, or program support are encouraged to apply if their experience demonstrates the organizational and problem-solving capabilities required for the role.

**This Role Is NOT**

* A role that requires fully defined change processes and templates to be in place before work can begin
* A technical document-control role focused on engineering, software, or systems specifications
* A role limited to maintaining documents without understanding the work those documents support
* A role focused on only one function rather than the broader cross-functional change workstream
* A role for someone who needs constant direction or step-by-step instructions
* A purely administrative role where success is measured only by completing assigned tasks

**Preferred Characteristics**

* **Highly organized:** Creates order across people, information, meetings, and competing priorities
* **Proactive:** Notices gaps, inconsistencies, and upcoming needs before they become problems
* **Adaptable:** Comfortable working across administration, operations, project coordination, and change-related activities
* **Self-directed:** Can take general direction and determine what structure or process is needed
* **Detail-oriented:** Maintains accurate documentation and tracking without becoming overly rigid
* **Cross-functional:** Comfortable coordinating with people from different teams and at different levels
* **Calm under pressure:** Can manage shifting priorities and competing requests without losing organization
* **Process-minded:** Naturally looks for ways to make workflows clearer, more consistent, and more efficient
* **AI-enabled:** Uses AI tools thoughtfully to improve speed, quality, documentation, research, and day-to-day productivity
* **Ownership-oriented:** Will step outside a narrow job description when something important needs to get done

Pay: $50.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* This role is open to candidates coming from administration, operations, project management, PMO, document control, change management, or related backgrounds. Briefly describe your professional background and explain which parts of your experience are most relevant to coordinating a complex, cross-functional transformation program.
* Some people do their best work when processes are already clearly defined. Others are comfortable creating structure themselves. Describe a specific example where you were given a general objective but had to determine how to organize the work, documentation, tracking, or process yourself. What did you build?
* Describe specifically how you currently use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar platforms in your administrative, operational, project-management, coordination, or documentation workflow.
* Describe your experience coordinating work across multiple teams, departments, clients, or business functions. How did you keep information consistent and ensure everyone had what they needed?

Work Location: Remote

**Job Description**  
The Job File Coordinator is responsible for managing and maintaining accurate, complete, and timely job files throughout the lifecycle of restoration projects. This position serves as a key point of coordination between production teams, customers, insurance carriers, and internal departments to ensure all required documentation is collected, reviewed, and processed appropriately. The Job File Coordinator plays an important role in maintaining organized workflows, supporting timely billing and job closeout, and delivering a high level of customer service.

* Maintain accurate customer, insurance, and project information within company systems.
* Prepare and organize completed job files for billing and final closeout.
* Prepare detailed and itemized invoices and supporting documentation as required.
* Ensure job files meet SERVPRO, customer, insurance carrier, and program requirements.
* Communicate professionally with customers, insurance adjusters, agents, production staff, and other internal and external contacts regarding job status and documentation needs.
* Provide timely updates and follow-up on outstanding documentation, approvals, or information needed to move jobs forward.
* Assist with resolving documentation, billing, or job-file discrepancies.
* Maintain organized electronic and/or physical job records.
* Support quality assurance efforts by reviewing files for consistency, accuracy, and compliance.
* Work collaboratively with production, estimating, accounting, and management teams to support efficient project completion.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer, insurance, and company information.

cc898aee3dbf9ea61058.title: Salesforce & AI Automation Lead
cc898aee3dbf9ea61058.description:
**Recruiters & Staffers** - *We prefer to hire direct. Please do not solicit your services to any member of our organization.*

**Interested Applicants** - *The hiring team for this position will handle all applicants and communications through our Applicant Tracking System. Resumes emailed directly to other members of our company will not be considered.*

**Description**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced, innovative, and results-driven **Salesforce & AI Automation Lead** to design, develop, and implement AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and support our company's continued growth.

In this role, you will lead the development of AI agents, voice agents, workflow automations, and system integrations while maintaining and optimizing our existing Salesforce platform. Our goal is to automate approximately 80% of our internal workflows, allowing our employees to focus more on client relationships and delivering exceptional service.

The ideal candidate combines advanced Salesforce expertise with hands-on AI automation experience, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently manage projects from concept through production. We are looking for someone who understands business challenges, communicates effectively, takes ownership of their work, and consistently delivers practical, measurable results.

If you're passionate about developing innovative solutions, leveraging AI to transform business operations, and making a meaningful impact within a growing organization, ***we'd love to hear from you!***

This is a **fully remote position**, but we host several in-person company events throughout the year. The ideal candidate is willing and able to attend occasional in-person gatherings.

**Please Note:** *At this time, we are not accepting unsolicited contact from recruiters, staffing agencies, or headhunters. We respectfully request that third parties refrain from reaching out regarding this position. Our hiring team is focused on sourcing and engaging directly with candidates, and we prefer to manage our recruitment efforts internally. Thank you for your understanding.*

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **AI Agent Development:** Design, build, test, and deploy AI-powered agents and automations that streamline business processes across Sales, Claims Management, Injury Triage, and Client Services.
* **Voice AI Solutions:** Develop and implement AI voice agents capable of handling inbound calls, injury intake, dispatch coordination, and other customer-facing workflows.
* **Workflow Automation:** Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes and develop intelligent automations that improve efficiency, accuracy, and employee productivity.
* **Salesforce Development & Administration:** Maintain and optimize our Salesforce Enterprise environment, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, and other integrated Salesforce products.
* **System Integration:** Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms, including Microsoft 365, Aircall (VOIP), Calendly, and agency management systems such as Applied Epic.
* **Process Optimization:** Collaborate with leadership and departmental stakeholders to understand existing workflows, identify business challenges, and develop effective technical solutions.
* **Project Management & Execution:** Independently manage multiple technical initiatives from requirements gathering through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization, with an emphasis on completing established quarterly priorities.
* **Communication & Documentation:** Develop clear project plans, maintain accurate system documentation, communicate progress proactively, and provide regular updates to company leadership.
* **Data Management & Security:** Maintain Salesforce data integrity, user permissions, security settings, and overall platform reliability while protecting sensitive business and client information.
* **User Support & Training:** Troubleshoot technical issues, support end users, develop training resources, and promote successful adoption of new systems and automations.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Stay informed of advancements in Salesforce, artificial intelligence, and automation technologies, and recommend practical improvements that align with organizational goals.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration, development, or platform management experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
* Demonstrated experience successfully designing, developing, and deploying AI agents or advanced automation solutions in production business environments.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce architecture, Flow, custom objects, data models, security, and automation best practices.
* Experience with Salesforce Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Data Cloud, or comparable AI agent development platforms.
* Working proficiency with Apex, APIs, and third-party system integrations, including the ability to troubleshoot and modify existing solutions.
* Proven ability to independently manage technical projects from requirements gathering through successful implementation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical technical solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.
* Exemplary time management, organizational skills, and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment with minimal supervision, proactively manage priorities, and consistently meet project commitments.
* Strong collaboration skills, accountability, and a commitment to delivering reliable, measurable business results.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing AI-powered voice agents using Agentforce Voice, Aircall, Retell, Vapi, or similar platforms.
* Experience implementing AI solutions that analyze sales calls, meeting transcripts, or employee interactions to provide actionable feedback.
* Experience with middleware and workflow automation platforms such as MuleSoft, Workato, n8n, or Zapier.
* Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Field Service, Data Cloud, and Account Engagement.
* Familiarity with commercial insurance, Workers' Compensation, claims management, or insurance agency management systems, particularly Applied Epic.
* Salesforce certifications such as Agentforce Specialist, Platform App Builder, Advanced Administrator, or Platform Developer.
* Experience working directly with executive leadership in a small or midsize organization.
* Demonstrated success implementing automation solutions that deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency, employee productivity, or service quality.

**Compensation**
----------------

$130,000 - $150,000 yearly

**About Whiteboard Risk & Insurance Solutions**
-----------------------------------------------

**Who We Are:**

We are a modern commercial insurance agency with a very unique platform of services that helps businesses that struggle with workers' compensation injuries. We've spent the last ten years honing our niche and developing a highly unique product that drives unrivaled results for clients.

We solve challenges that business owners typically don't even know exist until they meet us. It makes it difficult to get our foot in the door - but once we have the opportunity to educate them on Workers' Comp and how our platform resolves a number of common problems with their insurance, most of them wish they'd heard of this much sooner!

**Employee Benefits:**

* Competitive Compensation
* Monthly Health & Wellness Credit
* Employer-Sponsored Health Care Plan
* Retirement Plan with up to a 5% match
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Training & Development Support

**The Company:**  
Kinter is a family business obsessed with making retail display hardware easier for our customers. We’ve been manufacturing and distributing retail display hardware for over 40 years. Our approach to business is simple — treat each other and our customers like family.  
  
**Summary/Objective:**  
The Field Operations Support Specialist travels to customer retail locations to survey stores for ESL conversion readiness and determine required Kinter components. The role takes accurate measurements and part counts, documenting data using Microsoft Excel and internal templates, tests fit and function across various store fixture environments in accordance with established standards and guidelines and also assists with day-to-day operational activities by supporting reporting, technology systems, and process improvements efforts. The standard schedule is typically Monday–Friday; however, hours may need to flex during travel weeks depending on flight schedules, store access windows, and project timelines. **The pay range for this role is fixed at $50,000 to $60,000, commensurate with experience.** Candidates with strong, relevant experience may be offered salaries toward the higher end of the range, while those earlier in their careers can expect offers aligned with the entry level of the range. **This is a remote position and is only open to candidates who will work from Virginia, Florida, Colorado, or Arkansas.**  
  
**Essential Functions:**

* Travel to customer retail locations to conduct ESL conversion readiness surveys and identify required components.
* Take accurate measurements and part counts, documenting data using Microsoft Excel and internal templates.
* Test product fit and functionality in various retail fixture environments in accordance with established standards and guidelines.
* Document field findings, fixture conditions, and exceptions through reports and photographs.
* Assist with day-to-day operational support activities, including reporting, data entry, and process coordination.
* Support the use of technology systems, software tools, and applications used in field and operational workflows.

* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic math and measurement skills; comfortable using tape measures, calipers, and related tools.

d2ecb2db23873981efff.description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.  
  
We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.  
  
At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

**About the job**

The Patient Access Coordinator is Vynca's front line — often the first voice a patient, family member, provider, or health plan hears. This role owns every inbound call and, separately, owns direct referrals end to end (from providers, hospitals, facilities, and community partners) through intake and prep, then hands the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach. MIF list referrals are out of scope for this role. The ideal candidate is warm and calm under pressure, catches clinical red flags, and keeps calls and referrals moving without anything falling through the cracks.  
  
*At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states with a strong preference for those EST based: California, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington.*

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound calls, meeting call answer rate and service level targets, and flagging volume or staffing risks to the Shared Services Manager.
* Assess each caller's need and route or warm-transfer to the right department the first time; identify clinical trigger words and escalate to triage immediately per protocol.
* De-escalate distressed or upset callers, and know when to involve a supervisor or clinician.
* Own direct referrals end to end (providers, hospitals, facilities, community partners); MIF list referrals are out of scope.
* Complete intake for each direct referral — pre-admission assessment, scheduling support, and documentation — then hand off the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach.
* Document call and intake details accurately in real time; maintain databases, logs, census sheets, and contact lists.
* Manage voicemails, callback queues, and after-hours messages within established timeframes.
* Meet call handling and referral prep targets; follow scripts and quality standards; participate in coaching, team meetings, and huddles.
* Maintain strict HIPAA compliance, and perform other duties as assigned.

**Your experience and qualifications**

* Associate degree or medical/business office training highly preferred.
* 2+ years in a high call volume role (i.e call center, medical front office, patient access, and/or or intake/admissions).
* Healthcare experience required. *Experience in palliative care, home health, hospice, discharge planning, or safety-net hospital settings, highly preferred.*
* Proven de-escalation skills with distressed or grieving callers, and the judgment to know what to escalate.
* Ability to recognize clinical trigger words after training (no license required); clinical fluency from training or experience alongside SWs, RNs, MAs, chaplains, or scribes a plus.
* Strong multitasker across phone, documentation, and multiple systems; reliable attendance; comfortable with Google Workspace, Salesforce, telephony, and EHR systems.
* Cultural competency and working knowledge of HIPAA, with the ability to manage difficult conversations involving serious illness, grief, and/or end of life care.
* Willing and able to work Monday-Friday 8:30-5pm EST with occasional evenings/weekends.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) required.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* The hiring process for this role may consist of applying, followed by a phone screen, online assessment(s), interview(s), an offer, and background/reference checks.
* Background Screening: A background check, which may include a drug test or other health screenings depending on the role, will be required prior to employment.
* Job Description Scope: This job description is not exhaustive and may include additional activities, duties, and responsibilities not listed herein.
* Vaccination Requirement: Employees in patient, client, or customer-facing roles must be vaccinated against influenza. Requests for religious or medical accommodations will be considered but may not always be approved.
* Employment Eligibility: Compliance with federal law requires identity and work eligibility verification using E-Verify upon hire.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: At Vynca Inc., we embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law.
* Environmental Conditions and Physical Requirements: Works with Vynca patients/clients remotely and/or in-person. Successfully performs the essential duties and responsibilities of the position through the use of physical activities as described below:

  + Regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, talking, use of hands, listening, and observing.
  + Regularly requires working at a computer for an entire shift (with appropriate breaks).
  + Regularly requires use of laptop and video-conferencing technology.
  + Occasionally requires reaching, stooping, bending, kneeling, and lifting items weighing 25 pounds or less.
  + Occasional travel may be required to perform job duties, attend training, or company events.

The primary function of this position is to ensure the accurate management and maintenance of customer, asset, and service data within SAP and other business systems. This role is responsible for entering and validating customer information, processing customer Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and warranty entitlements, verifying asset ownership, and ensuring data accuracy throughout the customer lifecycle.

  
  

The Customer Service Representative serves as a key liaison between customers and internal departments by maintaining accurate records, processing transactions, responding to customer inquiries through CRM platforms, email, and phone communications, researching discrepancies, and supporting operational activities. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, data accuracy, organizational skills, and the ability to follow established processes while providing exceptional customer service.

  
  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide exceptional customer service and timely follow-through to internal and external customers through phone, email, CRM systems, and other communication channels.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for customers, dealers, and internal departments by coordinating information, responding to inquiries, and facilitating issue resolution.
* Process customer SLA requests by validating warranty coverage, service entitlements, contract terms, and supporting documentation while ensuring compliance with established procedures.
* Research and resolve customer inquiries related to warranties, service contracts, asset ownership, equipment history, account information, and service eligibility.
* Utilize SAP, CRM, and other business systems to accurately enter, maintain, and update customer, asset, and equipment information while ensuring data integrity across systems.
* Effectively manage workload and prioritize tasks to meet customer expectations, service level commitments, and organizational objectives.
* Collaborate with internal departments to resolve customer issues, maintain accurate records, and support efficient business operations.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement that enhance customer satisfaction, improve data accuracy, and streamline operational workflows; partner with leadership to implement approved solutions.
* Record customer product quality complaints in accordance with complaint handling guidelines and standard operating procedures, ensuring appropriate escalation to Quality for further review and processing.
* Consistently follow documented procedures, work instructions, and company policies to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Up to 5% travel.

**Job requirements**

**Qualifications**

  
  

* The ideal candidate will possess strong attention to detail, a commitment to data accuracy, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* This position requires excellent analytical, organizational, and customer service skills, along with the ability to navigate multiple business systems while ensuring compliance with established procedures and service commitments.
* Candidates must demonstrate a high degree of accuracy when entering and maintaining customer, asset, warranty, and SLA information. The ability to work independently, collaborate effectively across departments.
  

**Ability to work standard departmental hours of 40 hours per week, including holidays and overtime as business needs require.**

  

**Minimum requirements**

* HS Diploma or equivalent
* 1-3 years’ experience in a customer service-related field
  

  

**Preferred requirements**

  + 2+ years of contact center experience
  + Experience with Customer Relationship Management Systems (CRM)Experience utilizing SAP

**Expectations:**

* Customer Focus & Professional Communication – Dedicated to meeting the expectations of internal and external customers through exceptional service.
* Communicates effectively in both written and verbal forms while maintaining a professional, respectful, and customer-focused approach.
